messages:
Samira Patel: Quick follow-up from today's postmortem. I created the remediation tickets and sketched owners/timelines. Need thumbs-up so we can add to the monthly remediation board.
Ben Cho: I'll take RWD-3489 (cache TTL tuning + metrics). Plan: instrument, run A/B in staging, then roll. ETA 9 business days.
Priya Narang: Assigning RWD-3490 to me (circuit-breaker + alert thresholds). I'll draft acceptance criteria and link test cases.
Theo Martinez: I'll support Priya with the harness and add a nightly regression for both tickets. Can have a Jenkins job by EOW.
Luis Ortega: I'm consolidating ops steps into RWD-3491 (deploy checklist + quick rollback). Will include exact kubectl cmds and a troubleshooting checklist.
Samira Patel: Proposed RACI for these: Responsible = ticket owner (Ben/Priya/Luis), Accountable = Samira, Consulted = Theo/SRE, Informed = Eng PMs + Support. Any objections?
Ben Cho: Fine by me. One note: add a label `postmortem:cache-blowup` and set priority P2 for scheduling.
Priya Narang: Agreed. Also let's require a staging perf run (50% traffic synthetic) before any prod flag flip. @Luis Ortega can you reserve the window?
Luis Ortega: Yes — tentatively Tue 2026-04-07 08:00-10:00 PT. I'll put it on the calendar and in the ticket.
Theo Martinez: ETA for harness + job: 3 days. I'll post the job link in the ticket once created.
Samira Patel: incident-bot, please remind owners 48 hours before due date for each ticket.
incident-bot: Reminder configured: alerts for RWD-3489, RWD-3490, RWD-3491 will fire 48h before due dates.
Ben Cho: I'll add load test notes to RWD-3489. snippet: `wrk -t8 -c200 -d2m "http://staging/cache-proxy/health"`
Priya Narang: Added acceptance criteria and QA checklist to RWD-3490. Marking 'needs validation' after staging perf.
Samira Patel: Great. I'll add a custom Jira field `remediation-owner` and a saved filter for `labels = postmortem* AND status != Done`. Will publish links in the postmortem doc.
Luis Ortega: Ops handoff: I'll include runbook + short voice-call script (in case oncall needs to escalate).
Samira Patel: OK — next sync check-in scheduled 2026-04-02 16:00 UTC (09:00 PT). If anything changes ping here and update the ticket. Closing thread for now.
